header.subtitleEmsoft: Generate SHT (EMSphinx) and/or Master Pattern (Kikuchipy) files for EBSD indexing
header.subtitleOurs: Self-contained forward model: auto-picks GPU or CPU per step, no WSL or EMsoft required

engine.oursTooltip: Built-in self-contained forward model — auto-picks the fastest hardware (GPU if available, else CPU). No WSL or EMsoft install required.
engine.emsoftTooltipAvailable: EMsoft WSL pipeline — Monte Carlo + Master Pattern via Fortran binaries
engine.emsoftTooltipUnavailable: Optional — requires WSL + EMsoft (not detected on this machine)

tabs.configureTip: Set crystal file, voltage, tilt, and compute parameters
tabs.queueTip: Monitor running simulations and view live logs
tabs.historyTip: Track file sync status to network share

ocl.noGpu: No GPU detected — CPU fallback will be used
ocl.backendUnreachable: Could not reach backend for OpenCL detection

inputCrystal.databaseTooltip: Pick a .xtal from the crystal database, showing MC/Master/SHT status at this kV.
inputCrystal.browseTooltip: Browse the filesystem for a .xtal crystal file.

outputType.shtTooltip: Produce only the .sht spherical-harmonics file for EMSphinx indexing.
outputType.masterTooltip: Produce only the .h5 master pattern for Kikuchipy dictionary indexing.
outputType.bothTooltip: Produce both the .sht and .h5 master pattern outputs.

params.sampleTiltTooltip: Sample tilt angle (70 deg is standard for EBSD)
params.numsxTooltip: Pattern resolution in pixels (must be odd)
params.oursElectronNote: ✨ The built-in MC uses ~25M electrons (capped at 50M) — the master is built from the normalized depth/energy profile, which converges far before EMsoft's 500M. The speedup comes from the dynamical master step, not the Monte Carlo.
params.dminTooltip: Minimum d-spacing (CRITICAL parameter for indexing quality!)
params.masterNpxTooltip: Master pattern resolution (npx). Higher = more detail but slower.

compute.lowVramWarning: GPU has {{gb}} GB — using reduced block size for Master Pattern
compute.threadsTooltip: Number of CPU threads for EMsoft programs

advanced.omegaTooltip: Sample rotation angle around RD axis
advanced.depthMaxTooltip: Maximum depth for exit depth statistics
advanced.depthStepTooltip: Depth step size for exit depth histogram
advanced.eselTooltip: Energy selection index (-1 = use all energies)
advanced.combinesitesLabel: combinesites — combine all atom sites into one BSE yield
advanced.combinesitesTooltip: Merge BSE yields from all atom sites. Leave unchecked for multi-element structures.
advanced.useEnergyWeightingLabel: useEnergyWeighting — use MC depth histogram to scale intensities
advanced.useEnergyWeightingTooltip: Weight master pattern intensities by Monte Carlo depth distribution.
advanced.doLegendreTooltip: Required when generating SHT files for spherical indexing.
advanced.uniformTooltip: Diagnostic mode — produces invalid patterns, only for testing.

estimates.timeTooltip: Rough estimate based on 501px / 5e8 electrons baseline on a mid-range GPU
estimates.diskTooltip: Approximate disk usage for Monte Carlo + Master Pattern output files
